mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events ( id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, payload, status, retry_count ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSONB), #{status}, #{retryCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, payload::TEXT AS payload, status, retry_count, created_at, published_at, updated_at FROM outbox_events WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, payload::TEXT AS payload, status, retry_count, created_at, published_at, updated_at FROM outbox_events WHERE status = 'NEW' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE outbox_events SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'
UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'
